method: Retain the existing attributed habit/routine curation, correct false positives, and read the newly discovered store summaries. Primary includes general habit tracking, routine tracking, gamified habits, and configurable bad-habit tracking. Dedicated habit features in broader productivity/wellness apps are adjacent. Single-purpose vertical trackers and unrelated keyword matches are out of scope. Size qualification is independent of category membership; Apple ratings never decide download qualification.
